# CGRX v0.1.0-alpha.14

This release includes the React graph workspace, multi-project catalogue, detailed file and symbol relationships, and graph analysis optimizations from alpha.13.

- Fixes the macOS PHP-validation HTTP disconnect test when the server closes the socket before the client calls `shutdown`.
- Preserves the alpha.13 graph and MCP behavior; the change is limited to the test and release metadata.
